yd:
Siri out of the box is frustrating, so Sharif Shameem (@sharifshameem on X) built a free GitHub repo that connects Siri to Codex, OpenAI's coding assistant. Codex now acts as his iPhone's voice assistant: it can read his screen, control apps and take actions for him, all in vanilla iOS 27. The result is a phone assistant you can talk to that gets real work done. The repo is 100% free.
